title: Casino and Lottery
body: Wagers spend wallet first, then bank. Every round and replay rechecks balance, limits, restrictions and availability. Play Again creates a fresh round; completed results stay unchanged. Payouts are Ottomans only.

games.blackjack: Dealer stands on soft 17. A natural blackjack returns 2.5× the wager, rounded down to whole Ottomans. Hit or Stand; Double on two cards; Split matching ranks up to four hands. Split aces receive one card each and do not pay a natural-blackjack bonus. Total committed stake must remain within the configured maximum. A five-minute timeout stands all remaining hands.
games.roulette: Single-zero wheel. Red, black, odd, even, low (1–18), or high (19–36) return 2× on a win. number:0 through number:36 return 36× on a win. Zero loses all even-money bets. Availability follows the current table configuration.
games.slots: Choose a configured wager size. Three matching chair symbols pay the configured gross multiplier. A matching Throne trio wins Chair Pot. A configured portion of qualifying wagers funds the persistent pot.
games.dice: High mode rolls one six-sided die for you and one for the house. Higher wins return 2×; ties return the wager.
games.coinflip: Choose heads or tails. A matching result returns 2× the wager.
games.holdem: Texas Hold’em Poker is available only in <#1557660895813963908> (🃏-poker-chair). Buy-ins are 500, 1,000 or 5,000 Ottomans, mapped to 5,000, 10,000 or 50,000 chips. One table may run at a time. Shared cards and pot state are public; each player’s hole cards and actions are private.
games.omaha: Omaha Poker is available only in <#1557660895813963908> (🃏-poker-chair). Buy-ins are 500, 1,000 or 5,000 Ottomans, mapped to 5,000, 10,000 or 50,000 chips. One table may run at a time. Shared cards and pot state are public; each player’s hole cards and actions are private.
games.lottery: Friday at 8 PM Mountain. Buy up to 20 tickets per week. One winner receives the full ticket-funded pot with no rake. Empty drawings skip; no system-funded rollover and no Play Again.

fields.amount: Whole Ottoman wager, or whole ticket quantity for lottery.
fields.selection: Choose one of the currently supported selections.

examples: /holdem or /omaha → choose buy-in → join privately → play in 🃏-poker-chair

steps: Read the wager and current rules.
Commit a wager only after choosing your selection.
Replay creates a new round with fresh validation.
